message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fuzz && cat >> /tmp/build.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fuzz
CFLAGS="-O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=address -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I.. -I../include -I../include/libxml -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -DIN_LIBXML"
gcc $CFLAGS -c xml.c -o xml.o
gcc $CFLAGS -c fuzz.c -o fuzz.o
gcc $CFLAGS -c driver.c -o driver.o
gcc -fsanitize=address -fno-sanitize-recover=all driver.o xml.o fuzz.o ../.libs/libxml2.a -lz -llzma -lm -lresolv -lpthread -ldl -o fuzz_xml
echo "BUILD OK"
EOF
bash /tmp/build.sh 2>&1 | tail -30

message.content: Now let me build the driver. I need to compile xml.c, fuzz.c, driver.c and link with libxml2.a.
